messages:
Maria G: Hi all — quick sync: LangChain + our Gateway + Orchestrator pilot kickoff. Goal is a joint sandbox + marketplace listing and a coordinated announcement. Can folks confirm readiness windows?
Aj Patel: I can take the LangChain integration owner role. Timeline?
Kevin L: From infra side we need a clear test matrix for lat/throughput and a cert bundle for the gateway. Share the checklist and we'll triage.
Sophie R: For marketing: embargo window is important. Also need partner logos in SVG + short partner blurbs. Can we aim for a 2-week prep? :calendar:
Raj (partner-eng): Reached out to LangChain PM — they want a week of internal validation before any public mention. They also asked for sample integration flow and an SDK snippet.
Maria G: Good — proposed cadence: week 1 internal smoke tests + partner-led validation, week 2 marketplace listing + joint blog. That fits Raj's ask.
Kevin L: Smoke test items: 1) end-to-end orchestration using gateway routing policy 2) quantized model load/serve on Dedicated 3) KV cache correctness with LlamaIndex pipelines 4) failover to fallback variant. I'll drop a checklist.
Aj Patel: I'll draft the SDK snippet. Example call to our orchestrator router:
```
# python pseudo
from redwood import Orchestrator
orch = Orchestrator(token=REDACTED)
resp = orch.run("llamaindex", prompt)
print(resp)
```
Aj Patel: Keep it small — LangChain folks prefer idiomatic samples.
Sophie R: Marketing asks: hero screenshot (sandbox UI), co-branded one-liner, and target customer quote. Who will get the quote from LangChain? @Raj (partner-eng)
Raj (partner-eng): I'll prod their PM. Also confirming HW partner (SigmaCompute) wants to be mentioned for performance numbers — they asked for a short SLA note.
Maria G: OK add SigmaCompute to the marketplace entry as "recommended hardware". Legal flagged a short attribution template — I'll send.
Kevin L: One operational request: add a smoke endpoint that returns a short diag + gpu-util metrics for gating demos. I'll throw up a quick `GET /_redwood/smoke` on the gateway. Deploy-bot, can you schedule a canary?
deploy-bot: deploy requested by Kevin L: canary to staging cluster at 18:00 UTC today. Status: queued. :robot_face:
Sophie R: For announcements: are we doing simultaneous press + blog or staggered? Prefer simultaneous if partner OK.
Raj (partner-eng): LangChain prefers coordinated release but can do staggered by 24h if we need extra QA. SigmaCompute prefers same-day.
Maria G: Let's aim simultaneous but keep a 24h fallback. Action items: Aj — SDK snippet + sample repo by EOD Fri; Kevin — smoke endpoint + test matrix by Thu; Raj — confirm PM quote + embargo by Wed; Sophie — draft marketplace copy + asset list by Thu. I'll own the announcement timeline.
Aj Patel: noted. I'll post a minimal repo link once ready.
Kevin L: Will add perf numbers and a short runbook for Dedicated capacity tuning.
Raj (partner-eng): Shared LangChain validation notes here: https://internal/notes/langchain-validation (they want us to test memory backends with LlamaIndex).
Sophie R: I'll prep a short comms plan and a slack cross-post for partners channel.
Maria G: Great. If anything blocks, ping here. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: small follow-up — test matrix needs a column for "sequence length" & "batch size". We'll default to 2048/8.
Aj Patel: For the sample SDK I'll include the router policy example and a small LangChain chain snippet.
Raj (partner-eng): LangChain sent logos and a short quote — dropping assets into the shared drive now.
Maria G: Perfect. Closing sync for now. We'll reconvene Thu 10:00 UTC for a pre-canary check.
